scientific_integrity: Unrestricted conclusions follow from explicit fort classification, packing case analysis, and fractional-cover equality proofs; independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple clique bouquets with one hub, at least two blades, and at least two outer vertices per blade. Uniform-windmill minimal-fort classification is prior work. Priority assessment is provisional and the tests are finite.
title: Parity gaps and fractional fort covers of heterogeneous clique bouquets
